name: Bilingual Editorial
tagline: A dark bilingual newspaper deck where Chinese and English carry equal weight through shared hierarchy, paired copy, principles and editorial process.

palette.description: Near-black and warm paper with one vivid vermilion editorial accent.

typography.style: Chinese serif display and sans-serif body copy, paired with Space Mono labels and Georgia English headlines.

best_for: Chinese-English presentations requiring equal language hierarchy, side-by-side ideas, editorial principles and clear switching.
avoid_for: One-language-only decks, dense engineering dashboards or photo-led travel stories.
